description: Request a public URL from outside your network and inspect the HTTP layer: status code, full redirect chain, security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy…), caching and compression headers. Use to debug redirect loops, unexpected status codes or missing headers as real visitors and CDNs see them, or to verify a web server / CDN config change after deploy. Use check_tls instead for certificate or TLS protocol questions. Returns a verdict and findings with fixes.

followRedirects.description: Follow redirects and report every hop (default true). Set false to see only the first response.

url.description: Full public http(s) URL, e.g. https://example.com/login

name: check_http

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: HTTP response inspection
